# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/multi-tenant-rag/security/advisories/new). Include the affected commit or version, impact, reproduction steps, and any safe mitigation. Do not include real customer data or credentials.

The project does not currently publish a response-time commitment.
